Hrithik Ravi

Hi, nice to meet you! I am interested in investigating foundational limitations of current AI paradigms from a theoretical and scientific perspective, and exploring new approaches that address these limitations. In the past I worked on "generalization" theory - but I've now come to view this theory as not only useless, but misleading. I am now interested in exploring scientific/physics-inspired perspectives on modeling deep learning, as well as developing new abstractions that better capture language, reasoning, and theory-building.

Currently I'm interning at Q Labs, working with Samip Dahal and Andrew Gordon Wilson on radically new optimization algorithms that will scale in regimes of limited data and infinite compute. I finished my Bachelor's and Master's at the University of Michigan, advised by Ambuj Tewari, Clayton Scott and Rada Mihalcea.

In Fall 2026 I will be joining UW Madison as a PhD student. Please feel free to reach out and connect!
